text: TEXTBOOKS Study the underlying framework 08 Connect stellar orbits, gravitational potentials, equilibrium, stability and encounters to the structure of galaxies and star clusters. PreparationMechanics, vector calculus, ordinary differential equations, distribution functions and probability.Our suggested routeStart with virial balance and gravitational equilibrium; for star clusters, follow encounters into relaxation and distribution-function evolution.
